requirements.title: ANY reduces a logical array with the .OR. operator
requirements.definition: ANY is the intrinsic operation that reduces a logical array by the logical .OR. operator.

pending.any-logical-or-reduction: Use a future logical array initialized with both .false. and .true. elements; compare ANY(MASK) with an explicit .OR. reduction over the same nonempty data so replacing ANY with ALL or COUNT changes the result.

requirements.title: ANY arguments are a logical MASK and an optional valid DIM scalar
requirements.definition: MASK shall be a logical array; DIM, when present, shall be an integer scalar whose value is in the range 1 through the rank of MASK.

pending.any-mask-logical-array: Use conforming logical arrays of rank one and two initialized to nondefault truth patterns; wrong-type MASK probes remain source-control only because this unnumbered restriction carries no required diagnostic.
pending.any-dim-integer-scalar-in-rank-range: Use DIM=1 and DIM=2 on a rank-two MASK and assert the required shapes and values; out-of-range DIM probes remain source-control only because this unnumbered restriction carries no required diagnostic.

requirements.title: ANY result has logical kind, scalar/rank-reduced rank, and DIM-dependent shape
requirements.definition: The result is logical with the same kind type parameter as MASK; it is scalar if DIM is absent or the rank of MASK is one, otherwise it has rank one less than MASK with the DIM extent removed.

pending.any-result-logical-same-kind: Declare a default-kind logical MASK and check KIND(ANY(MASK)) equals KIND(MASK); this observes the required same-kind relationship without depending on optional nondefault logical kinds.
pending.any-result-scalar-without-dim-or-rank-on: Initialize rank-one and rank-two masks with nonuniform values and assert ANY(MASK) is scalar by assignment to a scalar logical sentinel that changes to the expected truth value.
pending.any-result-dim-rank-and-shape: For a 2 by 3 MASK, prefill an expected rank-one result with the opposite truth pattern, evaluate ANY(MASK,DIM=1) and ANY(MASK,DIM=2), and assert exact extents [3] and [2].

requirements.title: ANY result value is true for any true element and false otherwise, including empty MASK
requirements.definition: ANY(MASK) is true if any element of MASK is true and false if no elements are true or if MASK has size zero; with DIM, each result element is the ANY reduction of the corresponding MASK slice.

pending.any-true-if-any-element-true: Use a logical array initialized [.false., .true., .false.] and assert the result changes a .false. sentinel to .true.; a mutant replacing ANY by ALL must fail.
pending.any-false-if-no-elements-true: Use a nonempty all-false MASK and initialize the observed result to .true.; assert it changes to .false., avoiding default false vacuity.
pending.any-false-for-zero-size-mask: Use a zero-size logical array and initialize the observed scalar to .true.; assert ANY changes it to .false., proving the empty case rather than relying on default initialization.
pending.any-dim-result-equals-slice-reductions: Use a rank-two MASK whose rows and columns have distinct truth reductions; prefill result arrays with the opposite pattern and assert exact DIM=1 and DIM=2 vectors.
